Elaine (Sales): Morning — quick check-in on a few pipeline flags before standup. What I did: followed up with MacroHealth on pricing, uploaded their security questionnaire (Q#481). Blockers: MacroHealth still needs KMS/HSM details and SOC2 evidence. Today: sync w/ Jordan at 11:30 PT and prep a short security pack for them. @Mike (EntSec) any must-have notes? :eyes:

Sam (SalesOps): Copied MacroHealth answers into the tracker: https://redwood.internal/sales/trackers/macrohealth — added `Q#481` row, flagged missing KMS and encryption-in-transit proof. No blockers from ops side.

Jordan (SE): On MacroHealth — I'm blocked on their SSO/IdP config details. Scheduled call 11:30 PT to walk the technical team through redirect URIs and SCIM. Will need an example redirect URI and an assertion sample from our docs.

Mike (EntSec): Thanks. For enterprise deals we need: 1) KMS key management model (we accept AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or customer HSM) 2) proof of SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months) 3) network egress controls (VPC options). I'll attach a checklist. For MacroHealth specifically, ask them to confirm whether they require customer-managed keys or are ok with Redwood-managed KMS.

Nora (RevOps): I'll package the SOC2 & penetration test summary into a one-pager for sellers. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec-one-pager (will add MacroHealth call notes after Jordan's sync).

Elaine (Sales): @Mike (EntSec) can you drop that checklist in this thread? I can forward to the customer's security contact right after the call.

Mike (EntSec): Pasting checklist snippet here:
```
- KMS: customer-managed? (Y/N) + provider (AWS/GCP/On-prem HSM)
- SOC2: attach latest Type II report
- Encryption: TLS v1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest
- Network: VPC peering / private link options
- Data residency: country/region constraints
```
If they ask about FIPS/HSM certs, escalate to infra team.

Jordan (SE): After the call I can drop a sample `redirect_uri` and a minimal IdP metadata snippet. If MacroHealth wants a demo of SSO flow we can do a 30m walkthrough.

Sam (SalesOps): Side note — Deal stage for MacroHealth is currently "Security Review" and forecast says close in 2–3 weeks. If security asks delay, update forecast.

security-bot: New doc uploaded: `soc2-summary-2025.pdf` by Nora. Link: https://redwood.internal/assets/soc2-summary-2025.pdf

Nora (RevOps): Uploaded the one-pager and added a section for KMS options. Elaine: I'll make a small slide with the checklist for your customer call.

Elaine (Sales): Great. Action items: Jordan -> SSO example and demo offer; Mike -> escalate if they require HSM certs; Nora -> one-pager + SOC2 link; Sam -> keep tracker updated and flag forecast if delayed. I'll post follow-up after 12:00 PT. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: security pack template updated in /sales/templates/security-pack-v2.md

Elaine (Sales): Thanks team — will update thread after the 11:30 sync. If anyone sees an urgent ask before then, ping me directly.@here
